highlights.title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
highlights.summary: Model Discovery Agent uses LLM for experiment design
highlights.detail: It couples a large language model with standard Bayesian machinery to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. This approach operates in the M-open setting.

highlights.title: Listwise Cross-Encoder Fine-Tuning vs. Agentic Instruction Tuning for LLM Rerankers: A Systematic Study in Medical Procedure Reranking
highlights.detail: The cross-encoder fine-tuned with ListNet achieves better performance on NDCG@3 and Spearman correlation, despite having significantly fewer parameters. This has implications for efficient reranking in medical procedure retrieval.

highlights.title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
highlights.detail: Needle2 achieves competitive performance with larger models while being significantly smaller and more efficient, making it suitable for deployment on phones, wearables, and smart home devices.

highlights.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
highlights.summary: Matryoshka training framework for language models
highlights.detail: The Matryoshka framework trains a suite of language models of increasing size in a nested architecture, reducing total parameter count and enabling efficient distillation and speculative decoding.

highlights.title: Meta is back with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, and open source
highlights.summary: Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal model
highlights.detail: Muse Glimmer is an open-source model that operates locally and supports multimodal interactions, offering a unique approach to AI applications.
